name: gate-overflow-enhancer
description: Personal GATE prep enhancer for GateOverflow.in

scripts.prebuild: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/icons && cp manifest.json dist/ && cp public/icons/* dist/icons/ && cp src/content/content.css dist/
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && npm run build:content && npm run build:popup && npm run build:sw && node scripts/fix-popup.mjs
